summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container in the rdflib SPARQL plugin, as the spec describes. Changes: Update(prologue, algebra) class in plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in plugins/sparql/algebra.py now always returns an Update, with the empty-request path applying translatePrologue to q.prologue[0]; evalUpdate in plugins/sparql/update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added to plugins/sparql/processor.py and exported from plugins/sparql/__init__.py; new test module test/test_sparql_prepare.py added. Nothing was run, per instructions, so the tests and black formatting are unverified. Changes are uncommitted. The initial-bindings test relies on how an empty WHERE {} treats initial bindings and may need adjustment once run.
